spans.s: अभुग्न a. (f. ग्ना) 1. Straight, not bent; 2. well, free from disease.
अभुग्न a. (f. ग्ना) 1. Straight, not bent; 2. well, free from disease.
आभुग्न a. (f. ग्ना) A little curved or bent.
आभुग्न a. (f. ग्ना) A little curved or bent.
अभुजिष्य a. (f. ष्या) Not a servant, i.e. independent.
अभुजिष्य a. (f. ष्या) Not a servant, i.e. independent.
अभू m. An epithet of Viṣṇu.
अभूत a. (f. ता) Non-existent, what is not or has not been.
अभूत a. (f. ता) Non-existent, what is not or has not been.
अभूत-आहरण n. a covert or metaphorical expression.

अभूत-तद्भाव m. the becoming changed of a substance to what it has not been before. (The notion implied by this term is expressed by the affixes called च्वि; the familiar instance is पयोधरीभूतचतुःसमुद्रम् R.ii.3).
अभूत-पूर्व a. unprecedented, अयमभूतपूर्वः पुरः Ve.iii.
अभूत-प्रादुर्भाव m. the becoming manifest of that which has not been before.

अभूमि f. 1. Any thing but earth; 2. no object for, स खलु मनोरथानामभूमिर्विसर्जनावसरसत्कारः Sak.vii., “the honour at the occasion of dismissing me was indeed no object for (i.e. beyond) my wishes.” or अभूदभूमिः प्रतिपक्षजन्मनां भियाम् Sis.i.42.
